hooks.command:
reg="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/../adrl-world-class"; if [ ! -f "$reg/tools/review_ledger_guard.py" ]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"ADRL register not found as sibling adrl-world-class; review blockers could not be queried before this commit."}}'; exit 0; fi; cd "$reg" && python3 tools/review_ledger_guard.py blockers 2>/dev/null | python3 -c 'import json,sys
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
b=[x.get("global_id") for x in d.get("blocking_findings",[])]
msg=("ADRL register blockers outstanding at commit time: %d (%s). Unresolved findings may be committed, but no completion claim may be made for their scope." % (len(b), ", ".join(b))) if b else "ADRL register: no structured blockers outstanding at commit time."
print(json.dumps({"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":msg}}))'

reg="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/../adrl-world-class"; [ -f "$reg/tools/review_ledger_guard.py" ] || exit 0; cd "$reg" && python3 tools/review_ledger_guard.py blockers 2>/dev/null | python3 -c 'import json,sys
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
b=[x.get("global_id") for x in d.get("blocking_findings",[])]
msg=("ADRL review blockers outstanding: %d (%s)." % (len(b), ", ".join(b))) if b else "ADRL review ledger: no structured blockers outstanding."
print(json.dumps({"systemMessage": msg}))'
